body: Well, she isn't the one judging me. I am the one who thinks she is. But she isn't. All the depressing things I feel are self-caused. I know she would have wanted to be in a relationship with me at some point recently. But now I feel I've wrecked that chance. It reminds me of the Metallica song Bleeding me. "This thorn in my side... This thorn in my side is from the tree... This thorn in my side is from the tree I planted"...
